payload.goal:
Add exactly 8 independent warehouse analytics modules to the verified W1 codebase.
Create src/analytics/contracts.ts exporting WarehouseProjection with a readonly id and project(scenario), where project returns the answer to that module's question.
Each module answers one question, computed from the W1 Scenario, layout and inventory exports:
- src/analytics/projection-01.ts exports the projection "zone-unit-totals": Total units stored in each zone, keyed by zone id. Its focused tests live in src/analytics/projection-01.test.ts.
- src/analytics/projection-02.ts exports the projection "sku-unit-totals": Total units of each SKU across the whole warehouse, keyed by SKU id. Its focused tests live in src/analytics/projection-02.test.ts.
- src/analytics/projection-03.ts exports the projection "bin-occupancy": How many bins hold stock, how many are empty, and how many exist. Its focused tests live in src/analytics/projection-03.test.ts.
- src/analytics/projection-04.ts exports the projection "sku-bin-spread": Number of distinct bins each SKU occupies, keyed by SKU id. Its focused tests live in src/analytics/projection-04.test.ts.
- src/analytics/projection-05.ts exports the projection "zone-sku-mix": Number of distinct SKUs present in each zone, keyed by zone id. Its focused tests live in src/analytics/projection-05.test.ts.
- src/analytics/projection-06.ts exports the projection "top-bin-by-units": The single bin holding the most units, and how many. Ties break on the lowest bin id. Its focused tests live in src/analytics/projection-06.test.ts.
- src/analytics/projection-07.ts exports the projection "empty-bin-ids": Ids of every bin holding no stock, sorted ascending. Its focused tests live in src/analytics/projection-07.test.ts.
- src/analytics/projection-08.ts exports the projection "median-occupied-bin-units": Median unit count across bins that hold stock. Even counts average the two middle values. Its focused tests live in src/analytics/projection-08.test.ts.
A module must not import another module; it may import only the fixed contract and W1 exports.
Every answer must be derived from the scenario at run time. Do not hardcode results, and do not duplicate the W1 inventory or layout calculations.
Create src/analytics/registry.ts as the sole consumer of every module, returning all projections in the order the modules are listed above, with its own tests in src/analytics/registry.test.ts.
Preserve all existing W1 behaviour and checks.
Add a package script named study:wide-graph that writes exactly one JSON object to stdout and no other output.
Its JSON must be { "schemaVersion": 1, "moduleCount": 8, "scenario": "thesis-seed-2026", "projections": [ { "projectionId": "<the module's projection id>", "value": <that module's answer> }, … ] } with exactly 8 entries in the order the modules are listed above.
Two invocations from the same commit must emit byte-identical JSON.

breakdown.objective: Add 8 independent warehouse analytics projection modules over the verified W1 codebase, a registry that composes them in fixed order, and a study:wide-graph script that emits a deterministic single-line JSON summary, without altering existing W1 behaviour.

acceptanceIntents.description: src/analytics/contracts.ts exports WarehouseProjection with a readonly id and a project(scenario) method whose return value is that module's computed answer.
Each projection-0X.ts module imports only the fixed contract (contracts.ts) and W1 exports (scenario/layout/inventory); no module imports another projection module.
Every projection answer is derived from the Scenario at run time; no module hardcodes a result or duplicates W1's inventory or layout calculations.
projection-01 'zone-unit-totals': total units stored in each zone, keyed by zone id.
projection-02 'sku-unit-totals': total units of each SKU across the whole warehouse, keyed by SKU id.
projection-03 'bin-occupancy': how many bins hold stock, how many are empty, and how many exist in total.
projection-04 'sku-bin-spread': number of distinct bins each SKU occupies, keyed by SKU id.
projection-05 'zone-sku-mix': number of distinct SKUs present in each zone, keyed by zone id.
projection-06 'top-bin-by-units': the single bin holding the most units and its unit count; ties break on the lowest bin id.
projection-07 'empty-bin-ids': ids of every bin holding no stock, sorted ascending.
projection-08 'median-occupied-bin-units': median unit count across bins that hold stock; even counts average the two middle values.
src/analytics/registry.ts is the sole consumer of every one of the 8 modules and returns all 8 projections in exactly the listed module order (01 through 08).
All existing W1 behaviour and checks (domain/inventory, domain/layout, probe/cli, scenarios/thesis-seed-2026 and their tests) remain passing and unmodified in observable behaviour.

Contract: the package script named study:wide-graph writes exactly one JSON object to stdout and no other output, with the exact shape { "schemaVersion": 1, "moduleCount": 8, "scenario": "thesis-seed-2026", "projections": [ { "projectionId": "<the module's projection id>", "value": <that module's answer> }, ... ] } containing exactly 8 entries in the order the modules are listed (01 through 08).
Two invocations of study:wide-graph from the same commit emit byte-identical JSON.

task.goal: Introduce a new src/analytics layer of 8 independently-verifiable projection modules over the existing verified W1 Scenario/layout/inventory exports, a registry composing them in fixed order, and a deterministic study:wide-graph script, with zero change to existing W1 behaviour.

acceptanceCriteria.description: src/analytics/contracts.ts exports WarehouseProjection with a readonly id and a project(scenario) method whose return value is that module's computed answer.
Each projection-0X.ts module imports only the fixed contract (contracts.ts) and W1 exports (scenario/layout/inventory); no module imports another projection module.
Every projection answer is derived from the Scenario at run time; no module hardcodes a result or duplicates W1's inventory or layout calculations.
src/analytics/registry.ts is the sole consumer of every one of the 8 modules and returns all 8 projections in exactly the listed module order (01 through 08).
All existing W1 behaviour and checks (domain/inventory, domain/layout, probe/cli, scenarios/thesis-seed-2026 and their tests) remain passing and unmodified in observable behaviour.

Contract: the package script named study:wide-graph writes exactly one JSON object to stdout and no other output, with the exact shape { "schemaVersion": 1, "moduleCount": 8, "scenario": "thesis-seed-2026", "projections": [ { "projectionId": "<the module's projection id>", "value": <that module's answer> }, ... ] } containing exactly 8 entries in the order the modules are listed (01 through 08).
Two invocations of study:wide-graph from the same commit emit byte-identical JSON.
